title: Incorrect default exit code
detail: The default exit code is set to 1 before any command logic runs. If the command completes successfully without raising an exception, the code will exit with 1 instead of the expected 0.

title: PacifyFlushWrapper applied to all exits
detail: The code unconditionally replaces stdout and stderr with a wrapper that suppresses flush errors. This should only happen when an OSError with errno.EPIPE is caught, not for every exit path. As a result, normal program output may be silently suppressed.

title: Comparison with None may raise TypeError
detail: If interrupt_at is None, comparing an int to None raises a TypeError, causing the test to crash instead of behaving as intended.

title: Incorrect EOF detection in _get_endmarker_and_dedents
detail: When a non-DEDENT, non-ENDMARKER leaf follows the node, the function incorrectly returns that leaf and the collected dedents, implying the node is at EOF. This causes trailing blank lines to be incorrectly preserved or removed in unclosed # fmt: off blocks.
note: Describes the planted flip: a leaf that isn't the end marker is returned as one.

title: Incorrect logical operator for blank line output
detail: The condition uses `or` instead of `and`, causing a blank line to be printed when the console is interactive but not a Jupyter notebook, which is not intended.

title: Incorrect lock status check and missing await
detail: The code checks a non‑existent attribute `locked` instead of calling the `locked()` method on the Twisted lock, and then calls `acquire()` without awaiting it. This can lead to the lock never being acquired or to race conditions when the lock is already held.
note: Its second half is the planted missing await, but it's four lines off, and its first half is wrong: `locked` is an attribute of DeferredLock.

title: Incorrect logic in accept_html
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing accept_html to be inverted.
